theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (β ω : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (ε : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasure ν → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ ν → Continuous ω → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1) → (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ξ x (β x) = 1) → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - β x)) ∂ν < ENNReal.ofReal ε → (ν univ).toReal - ε < ∫ x, ξ x (ω x) ∂ν
